zh: 做得好！
十分棒！
辛苦了，做得很棒！
堅持就是力量！
給自己一個讚！
en: Well done!
Great job!
Beautiful work!
Keep going, you are strong!
Give yourself a round of applause!

zh: 每一步累積，都是照顧自己的開始。
小小的記錄，見證大大的進步。
今天的你，也值得被好好記錄。
持續記錄，讓改變看得見。
en: Each step you take is the start of caring for yourself.
Small records show big progress.
You deserve to be recorded today too.
Keep logging, so change becomes visible.

zh: 本應用程式僅供研究用途，由香港大學李嘉誠醫學院護理學院研究團隊開發。
研究負責人：林進彥 Lam Chun Yin（u3618332@connect.hku.hk) | 指導教授：張淑婷 助理教授
所有資料僅作研究分析之用，並將於研究完成後 36 個月內刪除。
本研究並無接受任何資助。
倫理審批編號：（待定）
參加者可以隨時退出本研究，無須給予理由，且不會影響原有權利。
如有任何疑問，歡迎聯絡研究團隊。
en: This app is for research purposes only, developed by the research team of the School of Nursing, LKS Faculty of Medicine, The University of Hong Kong (HKU).
Principal investigator: Lam Chun Yin (u3618332@connect.hku.hk) | Supervisor: Denise Cheung, Assistant Professor
All data will be used for research analysis only, and will be deleted within 36 months after the project is completed.
This project receives no funding.
Ethics approval reference: (TBC)
Participants may leave this project at any time, without giving a reason and without affecting their existing rights.
For any questions, please contact the research team.

zh: 孕婦或計劃懷孕人士不建議進行穴位按壓。
如出現任何不良反應，請立即停止自我穴位按壓，並尋求專業醫療意見。
本應用程式並非醫療服務，不能取代正規醫療診斷、治療或意見。
此為研究項目之概念試版，內容會按研究方案及督導意見調整。
en: Pregnant women or women planning pregnancy are not advised to do acupressure.
If any adverse reaction occurs, stop self-administered acupressure immediately and seek professional medical advice.
This app is not a medical service and cannot replace professional diagnosis, treatment, or advice.
This is a concept version for a research project; content will be adjusted with the study protocol and supervisor input.
